items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Louise, yeah. She says, “Oh, this is a passacaglia.”

ctx.x: Sorry? Louise, yeah. She says, “Oh, this is a passacaglia.” (laughs) For Christ sake. I’m a college graduate. But I feel, I like that record. I really feel good about it, and I thought Lovano… And there was one… Oh, I called it Ragman, that’s right.
